pkgmetadata.longdescription: QQ_Term is a QindaTK terminal emulator built for the QindaQt desktop. Each window is one independent shell session (the desktop's window containers provide tab and split grouping), with named launch profiles (shell, working directory) and a QindaTK AppWindow shell (menu bar, terminal surface) that follows the QindaQt desktop's theme automatically. The menu bar can hide down to a bare terminal (Ctrl+Shift+M), optionally by default for new windows. Configuration lives in ~/.config/qqterm/qqterm.ini.
